description: Figure 6 is a stacked vertical bar chart illustrating the average number of tokens as a function of the number of shots, with the total split into two components labeled by a legend: “Reasoning” (salmon/orange) and “Demonstration” (blue). The horizontal axis contains the categories “Number of Shots” ordered left to right as 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4. The vertical axis is labeled “Total Tokens” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 up to about 7000, with evenly spaced tick marks at approximately 1000-token intervals. Each category has one stacked bar: at 0 shots the bar is entirely Reasoning with a total labeled around 6393; at 1 shot the stack totals around 4500 with a blue Demonstration segment on top of the orange base and a red annotation above the bar reading about −1952; at 2 shots the total is around 4700 with a similar blue top segment and an annotation around −1613; at 3 shots the total is around 5200 with a blue top segment and an annotation around −1140; and at 4 shots the total is around 4600 with a blue top segment and an annotation around −1379. The bars are not presented as sorted by height; they follow the numeric shot order, and the only visual emphasis beyond color is the presence of red bracket-like markers and red negative-number annotations above the bars for shots 1–4.
